messages:
Maya K: Hey team, pulling a short bundle of Intercom snippets for AcmeRetail — captured 7 feature asks + 12 painnotes. Quick TL;DR below, want product triage before next-week renewal call. :wave:

Luis R: thanks Maya — can you paste the top 3 asks here?

Maya K: Top 3 from volume and severity: 
1) Per-route cost visibility (customers can't map tokens to routes)
2) Sticky auth/session replays (KV cache misses causing extra latency)
3) Better onboarding templates for SSO + Private deployments (docs + checklist)

Priya S: do we have examples of how they're tracking per-route cost today? anything in their billing exports?

Maya K: they provided this snippet from their finance ops: 
```
route, tokens, cost_usd
chat:customer_support, 1.2M, 1,420.12
api:search, 400k, 480.00
embed:batch, 50k, 60.00
```
They say they can't tie chat usage to specific product features (route names are opaque).

Owais A: product question — is this primarily a UI/console mapping issue or an API-level tagging problem?

Priya S: sounds like tagging + export transformation. if we let customers set a "route_alias" metadata that surfaces in the console + billing CSV they'd be unblocked. low-risk feature.

Jake P: adding context from engineering: we already surface per-token breakdown per model+route internally, but we don't persist custom labels. Implementation options: 
- quick: add a lightweight alias field surfaced in billing CSV + console (est 3 dev days)
- full: let aliases be used in routing policies and dashboards (est 2 sprints)

Maya K: Renewal risk note: Acme mentioned "if we can't show cost by feature we can't justify expansion". They are evaluating alternatives next month.

Priya S: Can Product put a T-shirt size and initial priority? I can mention expected timeline in the renewal call. :memo:

Jake P: T-shirt: S (quick alias + CSV). Priority: P1 for this account-specific ask, but P2 generally.

Luis R: For KV cache misses (ask #2) they gave logs showing latency spikes on session handoffs. Is that an infra tweak or doc fix?

Owais A: likely both — infra improvement to warm KV cache on session restore plus guidance in onboarding to persist session state. Needs engineering spike to confirm. Est: 1 week investigation.

Maya K: Recommendation: ship alias quick-win before renewal (fast dev path), and start a spike for KV caching. I'll offer a 2-week pilot to Acme to validate.

Priya S: I'll prep a single-slide ask for the Monday roadmap sync. tagging @Jake P and @Owais A for scope confirmation. :eyes:

cs-bot: New support ticket created: #ACME-402 tagging customer-success + eng. Link: https://support.redwood.example/tickets/ACME-402

Jake P: acknowledged, will review ticket and post estimated ETA in the ticket by EOD.

Maya K: Thanks everyone — if you want the full Intercom export I can drop it in the shared drive. Otherwise I'll capture the slide and ping product. :thumbsup:
